description: Design a realistic concert ticket with a perforated stub, event details and a decorative barcode — ready to download.

faqs.a: The ticket is rendered at 1200 × 480 px PNG with a perforated stub and punched notches, like a real ticket.
faqs.q: What does the ticket look like?

faqs.a: The barcode strip is decorative artwork for the design, not a scannable code.
For personal and novelty use — don't try to pass it off as a real admission ticket.
faqs.q: Can I use it as a real ticket?

howto: Fill in the event name, artist, venue, date, seat and price.
Pick an accent color for your ticket.
Watch the live preview update as you type.
Click "Download ticket" to save the PNG.
title: Concert Ticket Maker
